sentences.arabic: عَنْدْنَا قَطّْو وْكَلْبْ صْغِيرْ.
sentences.transliteration: 3endna qeTTu w kelb Sgheer.

sentences.arabic: عَافَاكْ طَعّْمْ الدّْجَاجَاتْ كُلّْ صْبَاحْ.
sentences.transliteration: 3afaak Ta33em d-djaajaat kull Sbaa7.

sentences.arabic: عَمِّي كَيْحْلْبْ الْبْقْرَة بَكْرِي فْ الصّْبَاحْ.
sentences.transliteration: 3ammi kay7leb l-baqra bekri f S-Sbaa7.

sentences.arabic: الرَّاعِي كَيْدِّي الْكْبَاشْ لِلْجْبَلْ.
sentences.transliteration: r-raa3i kayddi l-kbaash l l-jbel.

sentences.arabic: الْجْمَلْ يْقْدْرْ يْتْمْشَّى أَيَّامْ فْ الصَّحْرَاء.
sentences.transliteration: l-jmel yeqder yetmeshsha ayyaam f S-Se7raa.

sentences.arabic: وَاشْ كَايْنِينْ الْعْوْدَانْ فْ الْمَزْرَعَة دْيَالْكْ؟
sentences.transliteration: waash kaynin l-3ewdaan f l-mazra3a dyaalek?

sentences.arabic: شْفْنَا أَسَدْ وْنْمْرْ فْ حْدِيقَةْ الْحَيَوَانَاتْ.
sentences.transliteration: shefna asad w nemer f 7adeeqat l7ayawaanaat.

sentences.arabic: الْفِيلْ هُوَ كْبَرْ حَيَوَانْ هْنَا.
sentences.transliteration: l-feel huwa kber 7ayawaan hna.

sentences.arabic: رُدّْ بَالْكْ، كَايْنْ شِي حْنْشْ تَحْتْ الْحْجْرَة.
sentences.transliteration: redd baalek, kayn shi 7nesh ta7t l-7ejra.

sentences.arabic: الْقْرْدْ خْدَا لِيَّا الْبَانَانْ مْنْ يْدِّي.
sentences.transliteration: l-qerd khda liya l-baanaan men yeddi.

sentences.arabic: الْغْزَالْ كَيْجْرِي بْالزّْرْبَة بْزَّافْ فْ الصَّحْرَاء.
sentences.transliteration: l-ghzaal kayjri b z-zerba bzaaf f S-Se7raa.

sentences.arabic: وَاشْ كَايْنِينْ الثّْعَالْبْ وْالذّْيَابْ فْ هَادْ الْجْبَالْ؟
sentences.transliteration: waash kaynin t-t3aaleb w d-dyaab f haad l-jbaal?

sentences.arabic: الطِّيرْ بْنَى الْعْشّْ دْيَالُو فْ الشّْجْرَة.
sentences.transliteration: T-Teer bna l-3ash dyaalu f sh-shajra.

sentences.arabic: الصّْقْرْ كَيْطِيرْ عَالِي فُوقْ الصَّحْرَاء.
sentences.transliteration: S-Sqer kayTeer 3aali fooq S-Se7raa.

sentences.arabic: نَامُوسَة عَضّْتْنِي الْبَارْحْ فْ اللِّيلْ.
sentences.transliteration: naamoosa 3aDDetni lbaare7 f l-leel.

sentences.arabic: كَايْنْ بْزَّافْ دْ الْحُوتْ فْ هَادْ الْبْحْرْ.
sentences.transliteration: kayn bzaaf d l-7oot f haad l-ba7r.

sentences.arabic: النّْحْلْ كَيْدِيرْ الْعْسَلْ مْنْ الْوْرْدْ.
sentences.transliteration: n-na7l kaydeer l-3sel men l-werd.

sentences.arabic: شْفْنَا الدّْلْفِينَاتْ وْشِي فَكْرُونْ قْرِيبْ مْنْ الْفْلُوكَة.
sentences.transliteration: shefna d-delfeenaat w shi fekroon qreeb men l-flooka.

sentences.arabic: عَافَاكْ سْقِي الْوْرْدْ اللِّي فْ الْجْنَانْ.
sentences.transliteration: 3afaak sqi l-werd lli f l-jnaan.

sentences.arabic: جَدِّي هُوَ اللِّي غْرْسْ هَادْ الزِّيتُونَاتْ.
sentences.transliteration: jeddi huwa lli ghres haad z-zeetoonaat.

sentences.arabic: رُدّْ بَالْكْ، الْوَرْدَة فِيهَا الشُّوكَاتْ.
sentences.transliteration: redd baalek, l-warda feeha sh-shookaat.

sentences.arabic: الْوْرَاقْ كَيْطِيحُو مْنْ الشّْجَرْ فْ الْخْرِيفْ.
sentences.transliteration: l-wraq kayTee7u men sh-shjar f l-khreef.

sentences.arabic: هَادْ النّْخْلَة كَتْعْطِي بْزَّافْ دْ التّْمْرْ.
sentences.transliteration: haad n-nakhla kat3Ti bzaaf d t-tmer.

sentences.arabic: فُوقَاشْ كَتْقْطْفْ الْفَاكْيَة مْنْ الْجْنَانْ؟
sentences.transliteration: fuqaash katqTef l-faakya men l-jnaan?

sentences.arabic: الشّْمْسْ سْخُونَة بْزَّافْ فْ الصَّحْرَاء.
sentences.transliteration: sh-shems skhoona bzaaf f S-Se7raa.

sentences.arabic: شُوفْ الْقْمْرْ وْالنّْجُومْ هَادْ اللِّيلَة.
sentences.transliteration: shoof l-qmer w n-njoom haad l-leela.

sentences.arabic: كَنْمْشِيوْ لِلْبْلَاجْ كُلّْ نْهَارْ جُمْعَة.
sentences.transliteration: kanmshiw l l-plaaj kull nhaar jum3a.

sentences.arabic: طْلْعُو لِلْجْبَلْ وْنْعْسُو فْ مْغَارَة.
sentences.transliteration: Tel3u l l-jbel w n3su f mghaara.

sentences.arabic: الْوَادْ كَيْدُوزْ وْسْطْ الْوَادِي الْخْضْرْ.
sentences.transliteration: l-waad kaydooz wesT l-waadi l-khDer.

sentences.arabic: مَا كَايْنَة حْتَّى غَيْمَة فْ السّْمَا الْيُومْ.
sentences.transliteration: ma kayna 7tta ghayma f s-smaa lyoom.
